title: Your course was updated
moved: On {date}, your course was moved from version {from} to version {to}.
kept: Your answers and the lessons you completed stay in your learning record.
checkpoints: A checkpoint you passed on the earlier version may ask you to pass it again, and new lessons may have been added.
deadlines: Your deadlines and limits are unchanged.
carried: {count, plural, one {# checkpoint you passed was unchanged, so your pass still counts.} other {# checkpoints you passed were unchanged, so your passes still count.}}
personal.accepted: As you chose, your personal changes were set aside for the new version. They are archived, not deleted: you can still see them under your personal changes and in your data export.
personal.forced: Your course team moved you even though you had personal changes. Those changes are archived, not deleted: you can still see them under your personal changes and in your data export.
offer.title: Your course has a new version
offer.body: Version {to} of your course is available (you are on {from}). Moving keeps your progress where it can, but drops your personal changes: {changes}. Move now?
offer.bodyUnlisted: Version {to} of your course is available (you are on {from}). Moving keeps your progress where it can, but drops your personal changes. Move now?
offer.more: {changes} and {count, plural, one {# more} other {# more}}
offer.keeps: {lessons, plural, =0 {No completed lessons move with you yet.} one {# completed lesson stays completed.} other {# completed lessons stay completed.}} {again, plural, =0 {} one {You would pass # checkpoint again.} other {You would pass # checkpoints again.}}
offer.archived: Your personal changes are archived, not deleted: you can still see them under your personal changes and in your data export.
offer.moved: Done: you are on the new version now.
offer.waiting: You will be moved as soon as you finish what you are doing.
offer.declined: You stay on this version, with your personal changes.
offer.withdrawn: This offer no longer applies, so nothing changed. Your course team can help if you still want to move.
offer.failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
